svg.title: SkillScout tech stack
svg.desc: Public APIs (Jobicy, Arbeitnow, Himalayas, Frankfurter) send JSON over HTTPS to Apache Airflow 3, written in Python with requests, the Databricks SDK and the Databricks provider, running in Docker Compose with Celery, Redis and PostgreSQL. Airflow writes raw files to a Unity Catalog volume and runs a Databricks Job, whose Apache Spark notebooks (PySpark, Auto Loader) read them and write Delta Lake tables; it also runs dbt Core (dbt-databricks, dbt_utils, Jinja SQL), which sends SQL to a serverless SQL warehouse over the same tables. The Power BI service, in a Microsoft 365 tenant, imports from the warehouse; Power BI Desktop publishes to it; the report is embedded in a GitHub Pages site (HTML, CSS) that anyone can open. GitHub holds the code and the GeoNames cities: it provides the Docker image and DAGs, deploys the Databricks Asset Bundle, and GitHub Actions deploys the site. Failed tasks send Gmail alerts. Development uses pytest, python-dotenv and DrawDB.
